children: fell early Saturday amid an ongoing market selloff, which left leveraged bullish traders facing forced liquidations, leading to a 2,008% imbalance.
A liquidation imbalance of this size indicates that traders betting on higher XRP prices are being liquidated at a substantially greater rate than those betting on further declines.

In this context, XRP's total liquidations came in at $7.92 million: long positions came in at $7.55 million while shorts came in at $375,910, according to CoinGlass data. This yields a liquidation imbalance of 2,008%.

At the time of writing, XRP was down 3.09% in the last 24 hours to $1.27, extending its drop since Thursday's sharp decline into a third consecutive day. This continuing drop caught traders who expected a price rebound unawares, leading to forced liquidations.

Renewed pressure across global markets weighed on cryptocurrencies, erasing gains from earlier in the week. $667.71 million was liquidated in the last 24 hours across the crypto market, with long positions mostly affected ($528.30 million).
Santiment recently reported address growth for the
, reaching a record 8.24 million non-empty wallets. This extends a steady climb that has continued through months of price volatility.

Holder growth is still moving higher, with network growth reaching 4,772 new wallets in one day, the fifth-largest spike since March. Fresh participation is accelerating again, which strengthens the bullish case if the price increase continues, confirming the growth in users.

$1.40 is the first level to watch. A sustained move above it while network growth stays near or above 4,000 daily wallets would make a quick return to $1.50 more than plausible. If XRP loses $1.30 while new-wallet creation falls back below roughly 3,000, the adoption signal would be less convincing in the short term.
XRP's MVRV sits around 0.92, placing traders in net losses and creating a historically more favorable, lower-risk opportunity zone than when holders are sitting on large profits.

In positive news, Arf is bringing settlement liquidity to the XRP Ledger. The Swiss-regulated platform is partnering with Ripple to bring RLUSD-powered settlement liquidity to licensed cross-border payment companies on the XRP Ledger (XRPL).

title: XRP Hit by 2008% Liquidation Imbalance as Market Selloff Intensifies
